crossRefs.note: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to…
and he made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and…
Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and…
But if you will go, take action, and be strong for the battle. God will overthrow you before the enemy; for God has…
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.
Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be…
Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Stir up the mighty men. Let all the warriors draw near. Let them…
“He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.
translations.bsb: During the war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner had continued to strengthen his position in the house of Saul.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong in the house of Saul.
